newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato sees tax cuts in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato sees tax cuts in 1998.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Tuesday he hoped to lower income taxes in 1998 and institute reforms that could also affect deductions.
"I expect that in the debate over 1998, when a new model of individual income taxes is put forward, we can make a reduction," Rato said in a radio interview.
"We must not talk only of tax rates and marginal tax rates but also about deductions. This is a political debate and very important economically."
Rato said all European Union countries are making such reforms to increase the individual's saving capacity and Spain must do the same.
